description: Drive a spike of hydraulic pressure into in a line to a target. Deals ::damage ::damage_type (ignores armor) and builds up pressurised blood magic that can later release if those stacks build to much dealing damage based on last 5 hits when it releases. The magic will skip inflicting damage on party members. This inflicts 2 bleed stacks for every damage this does and for every hypertension stack on the targets it does 2 more damage.
name: Pressure Spike
